summary.en: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East push oil above $110, reigniting inflation concerns as Fed policy uncertainty looms ahead of big tech earnings. Tech futures slip on AI jitters despite record highs, while energy names benefit from the oil surge.
summary.zh: 中东地缘政治紧张推高油价突破 110 美元，通胀担忧再起，加上美联储政策不确定性 looming，正值科技股财报季前夕。科技股因 AI 焦虑回落，尽管指数仍处高位；能源股因油价上涨受益。

title.en: Oil Surges Above $110 on Middle East Tensions
title.zh: 中东局势推动油价突破 110 美元

impact.en: Oil spike from Hormuz/Uran conflict risks rekindles stagflation fears. BP profits more than double as energy supermajors boost on fuel prices. Transmission path: higher oil → inflation expectations up → Fed rate cut probability down → tech valuations pressured.
impact.zh: 霍尔木兹/伊朗冲突风险推高油价，引发滞胀担忧。BP 盈利因燃料价格飙升翻倍。传导路径：油价上涨→通胀预期上升→降息概率下降→科技股估值承压。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Oil price shock adds to inflation risk, constrains Fed cutting space, benefits energy cyclicals, pressures rate-sensitive tech and consumer names.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 油价冲击加大通胀风险，压缩 Fed 降息空间，利好能源周期股，压制对利率敏感的科技和消费股。

title.en: Big Tech Earnings Week: Nvidia, Amazon Lead 180 S&P Components
title.zh: 科技股财报周：Nvidia、Amazon 领衔 180 家 S&P 公司

impact.en: 180 S&P 500 companies report this week with megacaps as focal points. Nvidia and Amazon weigh heavily on indices. Earnings expectations set tone for risk-off vs. risk-on pivot post-April highs.
impact.zh: 本周 180 家 S&P 500 公司发布财报，科技巨头为重点。Nvidia 和 Amazon 对指数影响大。财报预期将决定风险偏好从高位后的走向。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Earnings miss or guidance weakness could trigger broad tech selloff and risk-off rotation, especially if oil/inflation backdrop worsens.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 财报或指引不及可能触发科技股抛售和风险偏好切换，尤其在油价/通胀背景恶化时。

title.en: Dalio Warns of Stagflation; Fed Rate Cut Outlook Dimming
title.zh: Dalio 警告滞胀风险，Fed 降息前景黯淡

impact.en: Ray Dalio says Fed shouldn't cut rates amid stagflation risks. Market priced for cuts; hawkish hold from BOJ reinforces global central bank divergence. Sticky inflation + supply shocks constrain policy easing.
impact.zh: Dalio 称滞胀风险下 Fed 不应降息。市场原本计价降息，日本央行鹰派持稳强化全球央行分化。通胀粘性 + 供给冲击限制宽松政策。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Fed policy pivot delayed or reversed increases discount rates, pressures long-duration tech, and favors value/cyclicals over growth.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - Fed 转向推迟或逆转将提高折现率，压制长久期科技股，利好价值和周期股而非成长股。

title.en: CATL Announces $5B Hong Kong Share Placement
title.zh: 宁德时代宣布 50 亿港元港股配售计划

impact.en: CATL seeking HK$39.2B (~$5B) to expand overseas production and capacity. Shares slide on placement concerns. EV sector faces margin pressure and capex intensity amid competition.
impact.zh: 宁德时代拟募资约 50 亿港元用于海外产能扩张。配售消息引发股价下跌。电动车板块面临利润率压力和资本开支强度竞争。

macroRisk.en: No - Company-specific capex/dilution story, but reflects EV sector margin and competition dynamics.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 公司特定资本开支/稀释事件，但反映电动车行业利润率和竞争态势。

title.en: Dow Jones Erases 300-Point Gain as Losses Deepen Midday
title.zh: 道指抹去 300 点涨幅，午盘下跌加深

impact.en: Intraday volatility signals rotation away from rate-sensitive names as oil and bond yields rise. Mixed signals: S&P 500 and Nasdaq make modest gains, but Dow underperforms on energy/consumer rotation.
impact.zh: 盘中波动显示资金从对利率敏感股撤出，油价和债利率上升。信号混杂：标普和纳指小幅上涨，但道指因能源/消费切换表现落后。

macroRisk.en: No - Intraday rotation reflects short-term flow dynamics rather than systemic shift.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 日内轮动反映短期资金流动而非系统性转变。

ai.en: Mixed on earnings prep: Nvidia guidance critical post-April highs. AI momentum tested as valuations stretch. Bullish on leaders, cautious on laggards.
ai.zh: 财报季前夕混合信号：Nvidia 指引关键，四月高点后表现。AI 动量面临估值压力。龙头乐观，落后者谨慎。

semiconductor.en: Chips long, software short per RBC. Supply-demand dynamics intact but cyclical headwinds possible if demand weakens.
semiconductor.zh: 芯片长期乐观、软件短期谨慎（RBC）。供需基本面仍好，但需求下滑可能引发周期压力。

bigTech.en: Megacaps test this week with earnings. Oil pressure on consumer names, AI optimism on leaders. Rotation risk elevated.
bigTech.zh: 科技巨头本周财报测试。油价施压消费相关股，AI 乐观支撑龙头。轮动风险上升。

energy.en: Oil surge above $110 boosts XOM, CVX, BP. Energy supermajors outperform on trading contributions. Favored style in inflation shock.
energy.zh: 油价突破 110 美元利好 XOM、CVX、BP。能源巨头因交易贡献跑赢。通胀冲击下风格占优。

ev.en: Pressure from margin concerns and CATL dilution. TSLA, GM, F face capex intensity. Long-term AI narrative intact, near-term volatility up.
ev.zh: 利润率担忧和 CATL 稀释带来压力。TSLA、GM、F 面临资本开支强度。长期 AI 叙事完好，短期波动上升。

market.en: S&P 500 and Nasdaq make modest gains, Dow underperforms. Mixed signals: tech highs vs. oil-driven rotation. Risk-on sentiment fading.
market.zh: 标普和纳指小幅上涨，道指表现落后。信号混杂：科技高位 vs. 油价驱动的轮动。风险偏好情绪消退。

preciousMetals.en: Benefit from stagflation hedge demand. GLD, SLV favored as inflation risks rise. Safe-haven flows potential if geopolitics escalates.
preciousMetals.zh: 滞胀对冲需求支撑。通胀风险上升利好 GLD、SLV。若地缘政治升级，避险资金可能流入。

oil.en: Hormuz tension and Iran war risk push oil above $110. BP, XOM, CVX report strong trading. Supply shock narrative dominant.
oil.zh: 霍尔木兹紧张和伊朗战争风险推高油价至 110 美元以上。BP、XOM、CVX 交易强劲。供给冲击叙事主导。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures down 0.16% near 7,160; Dow Jones flat to slightly negative. Nasdaq mixed on tech earnings uncertainty.
futures.zh: 标普期货跌 0.16% 约 7160；道指平盘略负。纳指因科技财报不确定性震荡。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y yield coiling for breakout; spike on oil-driven inflation expectations would pressure tech valuations. Watch for 4.3-4.5% level.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期收益率即将突破；油价驱动通胀预期推升将压制科技估值。关注 4.3-4.5% 区间。

dxy.en: DXY elevated as US safety trade amid global uncertainty. RBC Calvasina sees US as global safety trade.
dxy.zh: DXY 因全球不确定性下美国避险地位走强。RBC Calvasina 认为美国作为全球避险资产。

oil.en: Brent/WTI above $110 on Middle East tension. BP profits double on trading. Supply risk dominant narrative.
oil.zh: 布伦特/WTI 因中东紧张突破 110 美元。BP 交易盈利翻倍。供给风险主导叙事。

keyRisk.en: Oil price shock → inflation expectations → Fed policy delay → tech selloff. Earnings miss from megacaps could trigger broader rotation.
keyRisk.zh: 油价冲击→通胀预期→Fed 政策延迟→科技股抛售。科技巨头财报不及可能触发更大范围轮动。

note.en: Geopolitics-driven oil spike creates bifurcation: energy cyclicals benefit while tech valuations pressured. Earnings will determine if rotation deepens. Mixed tape with event-driven flavor.
note.zh: 地缘政治驱动的油价上涨导致分化：能源周期股受益而科技估值承压。财报将决定轮动是否深化。混合走势带事件驱动特征。
